concept: ElastiCache: cache frequent queries in front of RDS (read-heavy)
tests: The most cost-effective way to cut RDS read latency when data is frequently re-read and slight staleness is acceptable.
expected: Add ElastiCache in front of RDS to cache results of frequent queries. Triggers: "read-heavy", "frequently re-read", "tolerates slight staleness", "cost-effective".
why_not: The largest instance class — expensive; moving to DynamoDB — a redesign; Multi-AZ improves availability, not read performance.
